subject: Estimator / Scheduler, Scoresby: Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello FTA team,

I am applying for the Estimator / Scheduler role in Scoresby advertised on SEEK (job 95206941).

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. My coursework included cost estimates, bills of quantities and AS 1726 geotechnical site investigation. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge, tracking procurement and materials and preparing progress reports. I am based in Melton, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert says estimating experience is an advantage but not essential, which suits me: my estimating so far is coursework, not a paid role, and I want to learn foundation work properly from your engineers.

Could we arrange a short conversation about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Estimator / Scheduler, Scoresby
paragraphs: I am applying for the Estimator / Scheduler position at your Scoresby office, advertised on SEEK. The role covers reviewing drawings and geotechnical reports, preparing cost estimates and proposals, building installation programs and coordinating resources, procurement and timelines with your engineering and project teams.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In that diploma I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, and studied AS 1726 for geotechnical site investigations.

From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works in the Philippines, tracking procurement and materials and preparing site reports, material records and progress reports. Before that I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day and reviewing drawings against the work.

My estimating so far is coursework, not a paid estimating role, and I have not yet worked on screw pile or foundation projects. Your advert says that experience is an advantage but not essential, and the direct mentoring from your engineers is the reason I am applying.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My resume is attached and drawings from my study are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
